name: Pre-Review Validation
description: Run before declaring a task complete. All items must pass.

items.check: Are stop conditions verified and rules complied with?
items.pass: Stop conditions pass and rules are satisfied
items.fail: A stop condition fails or a rule is violated
items.fix: Re-read Stop Conditions and workflow rules. Fix violations and re-verify.
Revert violating change. Re-implement per constitutional law.

items.check: Have all referenced checklists been run and passed?
items.fail: A checklist has not been run or has failures
items.fix: Load each referenced checklist. Fix all failures and re-run.

items.check: Are edge cases reviewed and escalations resolved?
items.pass: Edge cases handled and no unresolved escalations
items.fail: An edge case unhandled or escalation unresolved
items.fix: Re-read Edge Cases and Escalation sections. Handle or escalate each item.

items.check: If lazy rules were loaded, are concerns correctly addressed?
items.fix: Re-read loaded lazy rule files. Check referenced rule IDs. Fix violations.

items.check: Are all mutations undoable with logged old values?
items.pass: All mutations undoable with logged values
items.fix: Add old-value logging before every mutation. Verify LIFO per UNDO-001.
Remove state-dependent branches. Produce identical DOM from identical payload.

items.pass: Hidden info protected in all paths
items.fail: Hidden info exposed in a public path
items.fix: Split into public/private. Use _private state keys per STAT-006.
